effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[Your Turn] When one of your Digimon digivolves into a Digimon with [Vegetation], [Plant] or [Fairy] in any of its traits, by suspending this Tamer, gain 1 memory.
